   130	## 5. Operational Contracts
   131	
   132	### 5.1 Initialisation Contract
   133	- **Preconditions:** Minimum voltage present on BAT pin to power the internal LDOs.
   134	- **Wake-up Sequence:**
   135	    1. Receives wake-up ping from Communication Bridge or previous module.
   136	    2. Sequentially activates the daisy chain for downstream modules.
   137	    3. MCU assigns device address via auto-addressing.
   138	- **Guarantees:** Responds to daisy chain auto-addressing command from host and completes self-diagnostic.
   139	
   140	### 5.2 Steady-State Contract
   141	- **Production:** Continuous monitoring of cell voltages with +/-1.5mV accuracy.
   142	- **Timing:** 
   143	    - Completes 16-cell voltage measurement in <200us.
   144	    - Synchronizes ADC conversion with "Global Cell Sample" command from MCU.
   145	- **Communication:** Bi-directional isolated daisy chain at up to 1 Mbps.
   146	
   147	### 5.3 Fault Contract
   148	- **Absence of Resource:** If BAT power is lost, module becomes unresponsive.
   149	- **Internal Fault:** 
   150	    - Asserts NFAULT and sets status registers if OVP/UVP/OTP limits are reached.
   151	    - Provides fault signal and heartbeat through the communication line.
